experiment: SFT-supported practical signal cohort with separate positive boundary evaluation

main_policy.measurement: Single and 2-5 same-channel meters; every bias 10-15 sigma
main_policy.parameter: Active nonzero-R/X line; true physical R/X/RX factors 0.1-0.5 or 2-5; reported model unchanged
main_policy.unbalance: Dirichlet(3,3,3) load fractions; actual maximum sequence VUF >= 1%
main_policy.hif: Explicit stronger curriculum: log-uniform 5-10,10-20,20-40 pu; two-terminal differential >=6 sigma
main_policy.topology: Connected physical branch-status changes; reported model unchanged; not full node-breaker topology
main_policy.mixed: Meter+parameter, meter+topology, meter+HIF; physical component individually core before meter overlay

boundary_policy: Retain representative below-main physical positives and uniform SFT-matched HIF Rpu20-200; never relabel healthy
model_training: Unchanged GNN/loss/optimizer/default config; five seeds0-4; validation-only best checkpoint
calibration: Independent healthy main calibration parents; empirical99th percentile, strict greater-than trigger
test_policy: Freeze all models and thresholds before test scoring; no tuning on final main/boundary results

comparators.previous_gnn: V1 frozen weights and scaler with new healthy-only calibration on the same main test cohort; explicitly a comparison on changed population

reporting: Report practical-main performance, acceptance/phase/asset coverage, and boundary performance separately; results are conditional on declared cohort, not general fault coverage
